description: Unit tests for the 'devices' module, testing network topology functions, neighbor calculations, and connectivity checks using pytest fixtures.

methods.name: add_bridged_link
methods.description: Adds a bridged link between two devices by updating their bridged_links sets.

methods.name: assert_expected_neighbors
methods.description: Helper function to verify that a device's neighbors match expected indices.

methods.name: test_neighbors_chain
methods.description: Tests neighbor calculation in a chain network topology.

methods.name: test_neighbors_star
methods.description: Tests neighbor calculation in a star network topology.

methods.name: test_neighbors_tree
methods.description: Tests neighbor calculation in a tree network topology.

methods.name: assert_backhaul_tree_connected
methods.description: Verifies that the backhaul tree covers all devices and starts from the root.

methods.name: assert_backhaul_path
methods.description: Checks that a backhaul path matches a sequence of device indices.

methods.name: test_connectivity_chain
methods.description: Tests network connectivity in a chain topology.

methods.name: test_connectivity_star
methods.description: Tests network connectivity in a star topology.

methods.name: test_connectivity_tree
methods.description: Tests network connectivity in a tree topology.

methods.name: test_connectivity_chain_broken
methods.description: Verifies network behavior after breaking a link in a chain topology.

methods.name: test_connectivity_chain_loop
methods.description: Checks detection of loops in a chain network when a link is added.
